symbol.title: Transverse-field Ising chain
symbol.desc: Nearest-neighbor ZZ coupling with a transverse X field on an extending qubit chain.

symbol.title: Anisotropic XXZ exchange
symbol.desc: Three spin components share a nearest-neighbor bond; the Z coupling has anisotropy Delta.

symbol.title: Square J1-J2 antiferromagnet
symbol.desc: Square nearest-neighbor bonds and both diagonal next-nearest-neighbor bonds; one plaquette is highlighted.

symbol.title: Kagome antiferromagnet
symbol.desc: A kagome network of corner-sharing triangles, not an edge-sharing triangular lattice.

symbol.title: Honeycomb Kitaev model
symbol.desc: A true honeycomb lattice with one X, Y and Z bond of distinct color at every vertex.

symbol.title: Toric-code star and plaquette
symbol.desc: Qubits occupy edges. A four-edge X star and a four-edge Z plaquette share two edge qubits.

symbol.title: Square-lattice cluster generator
symbol.desc: The local generator is X on the central qubit and Z on each of four nearest neighbors.

symbol.title: Levin-Gu domain-wall phase
symbol.desc: Triangular-lattice Ising spins form dual-honeycomb domain walls. A local spin flip acquires a domain-wall-dependent sign.

symbol.title: Scalar spin chirality
symbol.desc: Three spins on an oriented kagome triangle with a counterclockwise chirality cycle.

symbol.title: Three-dimensional transverse-field Ising model
symbol.desc: Cubic vertex qubits with nearest-neighbor bonds, perspective lattice continuation and a transverse X field.

symbol.title: X-cube support geometry
symbol.desc: The cube has twelve edge qubits for an X generator. The inset separately shows the four edge qubits of a planar Z cross.

symbol.title: Haah code F and G supports
symbol.desc: Every cell carries two different qubits. Blue first-species support F is the origin and three single-axis neighbors; rose second-species support G is the origin and three face-diagonal neighbors.
